description: Returns the configuration of every monitor, or of those matching the filters (keywords, type, active, maintenance, tags, parent group). Use it to find monitor IDs or compare settings; for current UP/DOWN status use getMonitorSummary instead. Type-specific fields such as url, hostname and port are returned only with includeTypeSpecificFields; fields returns only the fields you name. Returns up to 50 monitors per call; pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

active.description: true: only active monitors; false: only paused ones

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous call, for the next page

fields.description: Only these fields, comma-separated, e.g. "name,url,active"; id is always returned. A type-specific field named here is returned without includeTypeSpecificFields. Default: every field.

includeSecrets.description: Return credentials in full instead of "***"; they then stay in the transcript. Default: false, or UPTIME_KUMA_INCLUDE_SECRETS.

includeTypeSpecificFields.description: Also return type-specific fields such as url, hostname and port (default: false)

keywords.description: Space-separated keywords matched against the monitor's pathName, case-insensitively; all must match

maintenance.description: true: only monitors in maintenance; false: only those not in maintenance

parentId.description: Only the direct children of this group monitor (not recursive); null for top-level monitors

tags.description: Tags a monitor must all have, comma-separated, each "name" or "name=value", case-insensitive. E.g. "production,env=staging"

type.description: Monitor type(s), comma-separated. listMonitorTypes lists them.

name: listMonitors

type.description: A single comparison, or a group of nested conditions

count.description: How many monitors this page holds

monitors.description: Array of monitor objects with common fields plus uptime/avgPing. May include type-specific fields when includeTypeSpecificFields is true; with fields, only the fields asked for. Credentials (pushToken, basic_auth_pass, bearer_token, headers, ...) read "***" unless includeSecrets is set.

interval.description: Check interval in seconds (min 1, no upper bound)

maxretries.description: Max retries before marking as down

type.description: Monitor type. Use listMonitorTypes for the valid values.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; absent on the last page

total.description: How many match the filters, across every page

title: List Monitors
